targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*)::double precision AS value FROM incidents WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at);
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT incident_id)::double precision AS value FROM audit_events WHERE event_type = 'REMEDIATION_SUCCEEDED' AND $__timeFilter(created_at);

WITH resolved AS ( SELECT DISTINCT incident_id, MAX(CASE WHEN event_type = 'REMEDIATION_SUCCEEDED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS healed, MAX(CASE WHEN event_type = 'AUTOHEAL_RESULT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed FROM audit_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY incident_id ) SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(100.0 * SUM(healed) / NULLIF(SUM(completed), 0), 2), 0)::double precision AS value FROM resolved;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT incident_id)::double precision AS value FROM audit_events WHERE event_type = 'AUTOHEAL_RESULT' AND message LIKE '%final_result=ESCALATED%' AND $__timeFilter(created_at);
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT incident_id)::double precision AS value FROM audit_events WHERE event_type = 'POLICY_DENIED' AND $__timeFilter(created_at);
SELECT COUNT(*)::double precision AS value FROM incidents WHERE ai_root_cause IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(created_at);
SELECT AVG(ai_confidence)::double precision AS value FROM incidents WHERE ai_confidence IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(created_at);
SELECT COUNT(*)::double precision AS value FROM remediation_attempts ra JOIN incidents i ON i.id = ra.incident_id WHERE $__timeFilter(ra.started_at);
SELECT COUNT(*)::double precision AS value FROM remediation_attempts ra JOIN incidents i ON i.id = ra.incident_id WHERE ra.success = TRUE AND $__timeFilter(ra.started_at);
SELECT COUNT(*)::double precision AS value FROM remediation_attempts ra JOIN incidents i ON i.id = ra.incident_id WHERE ra.success = FALSE AND $__timeFilter(ra.started_at);

WITH durations AS ( SELECT i.id, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r.created_at - i.created_at)) AS duration_seconds FROM incidents i JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT ae.created_at FROM audit_events ae WHERE ae.incident_id = i.id AND ae.event_type = 'AUTOHEAL_RESULT' ORDER BY ae.created_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) r ON TRUE WHERE $__timeFilter(i.created_at) ) SELECT percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_seconds)::double precision AS value FROM durations;
SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ai_root_cause IS NOT NULL) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2), 0)::double precision AS value FROM incidents WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at);
SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at) AS time, COUNT(*)::double precision AS incidents FROM incidents WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at) AS time, CASE WHEN event_type = 'REMEDIATION_SUCCEEDED' THEN 'Success' ELSE 'Failure' END AS result, COUNT(*)::double precision AS value FROM audit_events WHERE event_type IN ('REMEDIATION_SUCCEEDED', 'REMEDIATION_ESCALATED') AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;
SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at) AS time, failure_category AS category, COUNT(*)::double precision AS value FROM incidents WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;
SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at) AS time, failure_category AS category, COUNT(*)::double precision AS decisions FROM incidents WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

WITH durations AS ( SELECT date_trunc('hour', i.created_at) AS time, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r.created_at - i.created_at)) AS duration_seconds FROM incidents i JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT ae.created_at FROM audit_events ae WHERE ae.incident_id = i.id AND ae.event_type = 'AUTOHEAL_RESULT' ORDER BY ae.created_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) r ON TRUE WHERE $__timeFilter(i.created_at) ) SELECT time, percentile_cont(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_seconds)::double precision AS p50, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_seconds)::double precision AS p95 FROM durations GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at) AS time, AVG(ai_confidence)::double precision AS confidence FROM incidents WHERE ai_confidence IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT i.created_at AS "time", i.incident_id AS "Incident", i.job_name AS "Job", i.build_number AS "Failed Build", i.status AS "Status", i.failure_category AS "Category", i.failure_action AS "Classifier Action", i.classifier_source AS "Classifier Source", i.confidence AS "Confidence", ra.action AS "Remediation Action", ra.success AS "Remediation Success", ra.retry_build_number AS "Retry Build", ra.verification_result AS "Verification" FROM incidents i LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT * FROM remediation_attempts x WHERE x.incident_id = i.id ORDER BY x.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) ra ON TRUE WHERE $__timeFilter(i.created_at) ORDER BY i.created_at DESC LIMIT 25;

SELECT i.created_at AS "time", i.incident_id AS "Incident", i.job_name AS "Job", i.build_number AS "Failed Build", i.failure_category AS "Final Category", i.classifier_source AS "Decision Source", i.ai_confidence AS "AI Confidence", i.ai_root_cause AS "AI Root Cause", i.ai_reasoning AS "AI Reasoning" FROM incidents i WHERE i.ai_root_cause IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(i.created_at) ORDER BY i.created_at DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT ae.created_at AS "time", i.incident_id AS "Incident", i.job_name AS "Job", i.build_number AS "Build", i.failure_category AS "Category", ae.event_type AS "Event Type", ae.message AS "Message" FROM audit_events ae JOIN incidents i ON i.id = ae.incident_id WHERE ae.event_type = 'AUTOHEAL_RESULT' AND $__timeFilter(ae.created_at) ORDER BY ae.created_at DESC LIMIT 25;

SELECT ae.created_at AS "time", i.incident_id AS "Incident", i.job_name AS "Job", i.build_number AS "Build", ae.event_type AS "Event", ae.message AS "Message" FROM audit_events ae JOIN incidents i ON i.id = ae.incident_id WHERE $__timeFilter(ae.created_at) ORDER BY ae.created_at DESC LIMIT 40;
